title: Chicago Electric Boat Company
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests rent electric boats to cruise the Chicago River or Lake Michigan. Boats include picnic-style Duffys, pontoons, vintage retro boats, and luxury yachts. Drivers must be 21+, have a valid driver's license, and receive a safety tutorial before departure.
extraNote: Multiple locations including Marina City Downtown, City Winery Downtown, Chicago Water Plaza Downtown, Rockwell North Branch, and Chicago Lakefront on Lake Michigan.
